summary: Toman is a large predatory snakehead native to Malaysian freshwaters. Its bright red striped juveniles change dramatically as they become darker, bulkier adults.
nativeRange: Southeast Asia, including the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, Java and Borneo.

features: Long body with a large mouth
Adults have a dark purplish upper body and a broad stripe along the side
Juveniles are orange-red with black horizontal stripes

lookAlikes.difference: Haruan has dark chevron markings; juvenile toman instead has red-orange colouring with black lengthwise stripes.

habitat.description: Deep still water and slow channels in rivers, lakes and reservoirs.
habitat.diet: Predatory; eats fish and other animals such as frogs.

eating: Cultured for food in Malaysia and several neighbouring countries.
